text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, yeah... Air Shakur was trying her 
best too, though.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
That run was a bit disappointing. *Sigh*, 
isn't there anyone good around?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Cup over and the gap 
between him and the Senior Class laid 
bare, the appraisal of Air Shakur 
completely reversed.

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—My take on Air Shakur? She's just... 
incredible, you know? Got that real sharp 
edge to her!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"You can tell who's stronger by looking at 
their record, but... well, I wonder how 
true that really is."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you know, her generation doesn't 
really have many main character types like 
the ones above, right?"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"If only there were a formidable rival, we 
could say for sure that she's the real 
deal."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Normally, in any era, there are 
rivals who clash their dreams and pride 
against each other, but..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“Curiously, there were none this time 
around. There were girls with potential, 
but... perhaps they just couldn't make it 
in time.”

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Well, felt more like a stroke of luck to 
me. Anyway, Air Shakur-san! Your fans are 
always waiting for a wave!"

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text: "Ahaha—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't erase it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"No need to erase it. That's just how it 
goes, anyway."
choice_data_list: Shakaal...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if you build up absolute evaluation, 
others will always speak in relative 
evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What isn't like that, what is truly 
absolute... is only numbers. But...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Being too absolute isn't necessarily a 
good thing either.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae" has once again mapped out a 
destiny where I never win another race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter what route or what pattern you 
take, you will always return "here".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So, that's... what they call destiny.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not like we have all the time in 
the world until the Tenno Sho (Spring). 
Tune out the noise."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you fret over every little thing, it'll 
never end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Air Shakur must have just lied. If she 
truly didn't care, she's the kind of girl 
who'd clearly say it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She leaves no room for vague nuances or 
open interpretation. Always earnest, 
always true to herself... She is a strong 
girl who is never swayed by the words of 
others.
choice_data_list:
(I should go after her. I need to hear it 
from her own lips.)

text_block_list.text:
"...What if they're overwhelmingly weak— 
—representatives of the 'weakest 
generation'......—"
> System.InvalidOperation

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. Get lost already.
choice_data_list: Shakaal

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah. I had a feeling you'd come.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'm just bein' messed with by that 
'God' guy."
choice_data_list: God?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Makes you wanna crack some ridiculous 
jokes too, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Everything so far was preordained... 
Someone up in the sky is laughing at me 
struggling, even though they know full 
well how it turns out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Surrender and stop being yourself. Change 
your ways. Cater to fate. Do so, and you 
shall be saved"—or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Even my "partner" goads me like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, I can't accept it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Having piled up absolute numbers... Clear 
enough for anyone to see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still, nobody truly appreciates me. Is it 
because of the era? Or because I lack 
rivals?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No. It's because I am who I am.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Air Shakur's face filled with utter 
helplessness, words slipped out before I 
could think.
choice_data_list: Did really nothing change?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Did your own feelings not change either?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Let's skip the troublesome back-and-forth. 
What are you trying to make me say?
choice_data_list: If you truly believe in the numbers...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You should be able to see that the path 
you've walked so far wasn't a mistake. 
First, accept that fact, and then—
choice_data_list: You should take pride in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I'm not your "partner," but...
I'm not your "partner," but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've watched her all the way up to this 
point. Even while plagued by nightmares 
throughout the Classic Triple Crown, she 
still overcame fateâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when trembling at the height of the 
wall standing beyond, she tried to 
challenge it. She never once stopped 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's all true. Facts I've witnessed 
firsthand... There are things only a 
"Trainer" can say.
choice_data_list:
You're the strongest. My reality hasn't 
changed.

You are the strongest. My reality won't 
change.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list:
No matter which route we take, I'm 
confident I'll tell you the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Wishful thinking... I'm weak. Alone, I 
never could have changed fate."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“An unpredictable factor—it was only 
because of you that I was able to move 
forward.”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"How the hell am I…… supposed to be proud 
of that?"
choice_data_list: That's wrong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she truly believes she couldn't have 
done it alone... then she is sorely 
mistaken.
choice_data_list:
What changed destiny was your sheer 
stubbornness.

What changed destiny was your sheer 
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: I chose this place because it's you.
I chose this place because it's you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur wanted to win. Resonating with 
a desire so fierce it could be called an 
obsession, I signed a contract to become 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you claim that was a factor, then she 
brought it upon herself. Even if I had a 
0.01 influence on it...
choice_data_list: To become 1, you needed 0.99.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She built it all up to that point on her 
own. All it needed was a breeze as light 
as the flap of a butterfly's wings. And 
so, she resolved to win, to overturn fate—
choice_data_list: Fate had already changed that very day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Naive.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "You always spout the exact same crap."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: “So that... is your pride at work, huh?”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "I kinda get the logic behind it, sorta."
choice_data_list: Let's teach Air Shakur a lesson too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone what you're made of.
Let's show everyone what you're made of.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you being serious right now?
choice_data_list: I'm always serious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're right. You are... indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It had always been like that. Without even 
needing to analyze it—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —My pride, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, maybe it was just... 
impossible for me alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, I got here on my own. If I believe in 
her... all I can do is prove it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —The only one who can hype me up is me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If they won't recognize me, I'll force 'em 
to look my way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Make everyone understand me... It's 
abstract, and the definition is vague. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? "Parcae"...?
> Do you start to initialize ? > [y]:

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What is this command...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Are you tellin' me to reset it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out, why're you suddenly turning 
this into sci-fi? You didn't prep any 
stage effects like that, did ya...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...So you're telling me to make it my 
"reality" from here on out, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah... You and I are different, after 
all.
